title: Patched Updater — endpoint update status
description: Contract between the privileged update daemon (writer) and the menu bar app (reader). Written atomically to /Library/Application Support/Patched/update-status.json, world-readable (mode 644).

last_action.description: PAT-508: version_blocked records that an install was refused because the version is in blocked_versions. PAT-1481: authority_refused records a terminal refusal by the signed execution-authority gate.

failure_reason.description: Populated when a deploy/install action fails or is refused. Platform-neutral: an agent maps a verification or authority refusal onto one of these reasons. missing_expected_signer / signature_untrusted / signer_mismatch cover signing failures. blocked_version = the candidate version is in blocked_versions; blocked_version_resolution_failed = an active block could not be evaluated safely before installation. sha256_mismatch = a pinned catalogue hash did not match the downloaded artifact. execution_authority_refused = the signed, fresh, unsuspended endpoint config did not explicitly authorise execution.

verified_signer.description: Signer identity confirmed at last successful verification — Apple Team ID on macOS, Authenticode publisher on Windows. null when verification was not performed or failed.

message.description: Safe operator-facing detail for an error or refusal. A consumed deploy request whose label did not resolve to an allowlist result is emitted as state=error, last_action=error with a specific message; empty success is never valid.

also_managed_by.description: PAT-277. Package manager that also claims ownership of this app on this endpoint. Platform-neutral: macOS emits 'homebrew', Windows will emit 'winget'/'chocolatey'. null when no other manager detected.

manager_drift.description: PAT-277. True when also_managed_by is non-null and the daemon's installed_version differs from the other manager's recorded version — the other manager's metadata has drifted after our engine updated the app.

coexistence.description: PAT-277. Package manager coexistence summary. Present when the daemon has run with coexistence detection enabled.

managers_present.description: Package managers detected on this endpoint.

also_managed_count.description: Number of allowlisted apps also claimed by another package manager.

compliance_findings.description: PAT-300/481. Configuration/CIS advisory findings. Absent until the daemon has run with compliance detection enabled. Guard on null/absent in all consumers.

volumes.description: PAT-481. For removable_storage_unencrypted: one entry per plaintext removable volume observed at collect time. Snapshot only — volumes mounted after the run are not reflected.

mount_point.description: Mount point (macOS: /Volumes/DRIVE) or drive letter (Windows: E:).

filesystem.description: Filesystem type as reported by the OS: msdos, exfat, hfs, apfs (macOS); FAT32, exFAT, NTFS (Windows).

encryption_state.description: plaintext = no encryption layer detected; apfs_unencrypted = APFS container without FileVault; unknown = state could not be determined.

provenance_source.description: Tool or API used to read the state, e.g. diskutil or Win32_EncryptableVolume.

os_update.description: PAT-273. OS-level update awareness. Absent until the daemon has run a SOFA-aware build. Guard on null in all consumers. Platform-neutral: Windows fills the same shape from WUA.

latest_os.description: Latest release for this hardware/major from SOFA; null when SOFA unavailable

target_os.description: Minimum acceptable version — from policy or SOFA/WUA latest; null when neither is known (PAT-2123: never falls back to installed_os)

severity.description: none=current; low=behind non-security; medium=behind security; high=deadline close or exploited; critical=deadline passed or exploited+past grace

actively_exploited.description: SOFA: target fixes a CVE with known active exploitation

release_age_days.description: Days since the target release shipped (null when release date unavailable)
